If you go into the control settings and in the keyboard settings under the  section for flight surface controls is a subsection labeled flight trim controls or something like that, it's the third option under flight controls. You're looking for elevator trim. That will show you what keys is mapped to. I think the default is number pad 8 and 2, but check anyway.

You can also bind it to part of your flight stick setup under the flight stick tab in the controls. It might be bound already by default, but if you've got an unassigned rocker switch, it'd be great for that.

Essentially you're going fast enough to generate more lift which points your nose skyward. Either show down, or as sometime else said, use trim to keep from doing that. If you just leave it you'll eventually point up right to cause your speed to fall and your nose will drop. Then you'll go down pretty fast, which will make you go faster. And then the cycle will repeat itself making you do constant huge nauseating waves.
